title: Metrics Dashboard — visual/manual rubric
setup: npm install; npm run dev. Use browser DevTools responsive mode for the width items.

items.criterion: At 360px width: single-column layout, NO horizontal page scroll, no clipped or overlapping element anywhere on the page.
At 768px: two-column structure as specified, no overflow.
At 1280px: four stat cards in one row; chart and category breakdown side by side below.
Chart fits its container at all three widths (axis labels and full series visible, nothing drawn outside) and redraws correctly after resizing the window.
The long seeded category label truncates with ellipsis; the 7-digit value fits its stat card.
Dark mode restyles the ENTIRE dashboard including chart axes/gridlines/series; all text remains legible (no dark-on-dark).
Theme choice survives a page reload (and a server restart).
